thread:
maria: Quick sync idea — can we move the weekly bug huddle from Friday 4pm to Tue 10:00am? :calendar: Backlog is ballooning and Friday feels too late for owners to act.

ajay: Tue 10 conflicts with my weekly all-hands. Would Tue 9:30 or Wed 10 work for me.

kevin: Wed 10 is better for me. I can make Tue 9:30 once every other week.

samantha: I prefer Tue mornings — gives time to triage before the rest of the week. Wed is a bit late for our release cadence.

maria: Thanks — sounds like Tue morning has more 👍. Proposal: Tue 10:00-10:30, but keep biweekly opt-out for infra/planned conflicts. Agenda (draft):
```
- 15m backlog grooming (prioritize critical bugs)
- 8m owner assignment + quick ack
- 5m blockers / follow-ups
```

ajay: Agenda looks good. Can we add a quick 2-min check on long-tail flaky tests? Those keep popping up.

maria: Good call — will fold that into blockers (5m).

kevin: Rotation idea: have a 3-week owner rotation so same team doesn't always get the heavy list. Something like: infra -> runtime -> platform. We can represent it in the invite description.

samantha: I'm happy to take Week A (this coming Tue) to kick the rotation off.

maria: Awesome — @samantha takes Week A. Kevin can you own Week B? @ajay Week C?

kevin: Yup I can take Week B.

ajay: I can do Week C. If something comes up we can swap.

calbot: Added: "Weekly Bug Huddle (proposed)" recurring event draft created. Invite pending approval.

infra-bot: Note: there's a platform maintenance window scheduled Tue 09:45-10:15 next week — might block participation. Check the infra calendar.

maria: Thanks infra-bot — ok for next week we can either postpone one week or hold and accept reduced attendance. What do folks prefer?

kevin: If it's just next week I'd prefer we still meet — we can record notes and reassign anything critical.

ajay: Same. Keep it and proceed.

samantha: Agreed — keep it. I'll call out any infra-related items I can't cover next week.

maria: Great. Action items:
- maria: update recurring invite to Tue 10:00-10:30, include agenda and rotation table
- samantha: owner Week A (next meeting)
- kevin: prepare to own Week B (two weeks out)
- ajay: prepare Week C (three weeks out)
- everyone: add 1-2 bugs to the shared backlog doc before EOD Mon so we can prioritize.

maria: I'll also add a short "how to escalate" note in the agenda doc so new folks know who to ping.

kevin: Perfect. One tiny nit — can we prepend the invite with a short poll line so people can react if they can't attend? e.g., add `React :x: if you can't make it` in the invite description.

maria: Done. I put that in the invite text and linked the backlog doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/bug-huddle-backlog

ajay: Thanks — will add my list.

samantha: See you on Tue. :wave:

maria: Closing — I'll post minutes after the meeting and rotate owners in the invite description. Thanks everyone!
